instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Huda Lafta Majeed
subject: 01_Cyber_Security
topic: The Governance Bridge & the Risk Cycle

questions.question: What role does cybersecurity risk management play between the two sides?
questions.question_ar: أي دور تلعبه إدارة مخاطر الأمن السيبراني بين الجانبين؟
options: It translates technical risk into business risk.
It replaces the governance structures entirely.
It removes the need for technical controls here.
It reports incidents after they have happened.
options_ar: يترجم الخطر التقني إلى خطر أعمال.
يغني عن الضوابط التقنية كلها هنا.
يبلّغ عن الحوادث بعد وقوعها فعلاً.
options_en: It translates technical risk into business risk.
It replaces the governance structures entirely.
It removes the need for technical controls here.
It reports incidents after they have happened.
questions.explanation: It is the bridge: it translates technical vulnerabilities into business risks that executives can understand and act on.
questions.explanation_ar: هو الجسر: يترجم الثغرات التقنية إلى مخاطر أعمال يفهمها التنفيذيون ويستطيعون التصرف بناءً عليها.

questions.question: Which set lists the technical controls?
options: Contracts, audits, and insurance.
Firewalls, IDS, antivirus, and patching.
Policies, compliance, and oversight.
Budgets, staffing, and staff training too.
options_en: Contracts, audits, and insurance.
Firewalls, IDS, antivirus, and patching.
Policies, compliance, and oversight.
Budgets, staffing, and staff training too.
questions.explanation: Technical controls are firewalls, intrusion detection, antivirus, and patching: the machine-level measures.
questions.explanation_ar: الضوابط التقنية هي الجدران النارية وكشف التطفل ومكافحة الفيروسات والتحديث: تدابير مستوى الآلة.

questions.question: Which set lists the governance structures?
options: Backups, redundancy, and response plans.
Encryption, tokens, and access control.
Policies, compliance frameworks, and oversight.
Firewalls, IDS, antivirus, and regular patching.
options_ar: التشفير والرموز والتحكم بالوصول كله هنا.
options_en: Backups, redundancy, and response plans.
Encryption, tokens, and access control.
Policies, compliance frameworks, and oversight.
Firewalls, IDS, antivirus, and regular patching.
questions.explanation: Governance structures are policies, compliance frameworks, and executive oversight: the decision layer above the tools.
questions.explanation_ar: هياكل الحوكمة هي السياسات وأطر الامتثال والإشراف التنفيذي: طبقة القرار فوق الأدوات.

questions.question: What happens to the two sides without risk management?
questions.question_ar: ماذا يحدث للجانبين بدون إدارة المخاطر؟
options: The two merge into one single team.
The two replace each other entirely.
The two are legally required to merge.
The two operate in silos without it.
options_en: The two merge into one single team.
The two replace each other entirely.
The two are legally required to merge.
The two operate in silos without it.
questions.explanation: Without risk management the technical side and the governance side operate in silos, each with its own language and its own priorities.
questions.explanation_ar: بدون إدارة المخاطر يعمل الجانب التقني وجانب الحوكمة في جزر معزولة، لكل منهما لغته وأولوياته.

questions.question: A missing patch is found on a server. What does risk management turn it into?
questions.question_ar: تحديث ناقص يُكتشف على خادم. إلى ماذا تحوّله إدارة المخاطر؟
options: A quantified business risk executives can rank.
A technical ticket for the IT team only here.
A compliance exception granted to the auditor.
An incident report written after the fact here.
options_ar: خطر أعمال كمي يستطيع التنفيذيون ترتيبه.
تذكرة تقنية لفريق التقنية فقط هنا تماماً.
تقرير حادث يُكتب بعد الواقعة فعلاً هنا.
options_en: A quantified business risk executives can rank.
A technical ticket for the IT team only here.
A compliance exception granted to the auditor.
An incident report written after the fact here.
questions.explanation: It quantifies the finding in financial and operational terms, so a patch becomes a ranked business risk instead of a ticket nobody funds.
questions.explanation_ar: يقدّر النتيجة مالياً وتشغيلياً، فيصبح التحديث خطر أعمال مرتباً لا تذكرة بلا تمويل.

questions.question: Is risk management a one-time assessment?
questions.question_ar: هل إدارة المخاطر تقييم يُجرى مرة واحدة؟
options: Only when an incident actually occurs.
No, it is a continuous cycle always.
Yes, once a year is easily enough.
Yes, one assessment for each system.
options_ar: فقط عند وقوع حادث أمني كبير.
نعم، مرة واحدة في السنة تكفي.
options_en: Only when an incident actually occurs.
No, it is a continuous cycle always.
Yes, once a year is easily enough.
Yes, one assessment for each system.
questions.explanation: It is not a one-time assessment. It is a continuous cycle integrated into enterprise operations.
questions.explanation_ar: ليست تقييماً يُجرى مرة واحدة، بل دورة مستمرة مندمجة في عمليات المؤسسة.

questions.question: Which five steps make up the risk management cycle?
questions.question_ar: أي خمس خطوات تشكّل دورة إدارة المخاطر؟
options: Detect, respond, recover, learn, and then close.
Design, build, test, deploy, and then retire.
Identify, assess, mitigate, monitor, review.
Plan, do, check, act, and then report.
options_ar: تصميم وبناء واختبار ونشر وإيقاف نهائي.
options_en: Detect, respond, recover, learn, and then close.
Design, build, test, deploy, and then retire.
Identify, assess, mitigate, monitor, review.
Plan, do, check, act, and then report.
questions.explanation: The cycle runs identify, assess, mitigate, monitor, review. It is the risk cycle, not the incident-response cycle.
questions.explanation_ar: الدورة: تحديد، تقييم، تخفيف، مراقبة، مراجعة. وهي دورة المخاطر لا دورة الاستجابة للحوادث.

questions.question: What does the identify step cover?
options: Probability and impact of each risk.
Controls and their cost for each asset.
Incidents recorded in the last year.
Assets, vulnerabilities, and threats.
options_en: Probability and impact of each risk.
Controls and their cost for each asset.
Incidents recorded in the last year.
Assets, vulnerabilities, and threats.
questions.explanation: Identify catalogues the assets, the vulnerabilities, and the threats that could reach them.
questions.explanation_ar: التحديد يجرد الأصول والثغرات والتهديدات التي قد تصل إليها.

questions.question: What does the assess step measure?
options: Probability and impact.
Assets and their threats.
Controls and costs.
Incidents and losses.
options_en: Probability and impact.
Assets and their threats.
Controls and costs.
Incidents and losses.
questions.explanation: Assess puts a probability and an impact on each identified risk, which is what makes ranking possible.
questions.explanation_ar: التقييم يضع احتمالاً وتأثيراً لكل خطر محدد، وهذا ما يجعل الترتيب ممكناً.

questions.question: What does NIST SP 800-37 do?
options: It measures policy compliance only.
It formalises the risk management process.
It replaces the technical controls entirely.
It lists the industry sectors at risk.
options_en: It measures policy compliance only.
It formalises the risk management process.
It replaces the technical controls entirely.
It lists the industry sectors at risk.
questions.explanation: NIST SP 800-37 formalises the risk management process, which is why it is named as the reference for the cycle.
questions.explanation_ar: NIST SP 800-37 يُقنن عملية إدارة المخاطر، ولهذا يُذكر كمرجع للدورة.

questions.question: Why must the cycle keep running?
options: The budget changes every single year.
The staff changes every single year.
New vulnerabilities emerge constantly.
The auditors require quarterly reports.
options_en: The budget changes every single year.
The staff changes every single year.
New vulnerabilities emerge constantly.
The auditors require quarterly reports.
questions.explanation: New vulnerabilities appear continuously and the risk profile moves with them, so an assessment that stops is already out of date.
questions.explanation_ar: ثغرات جديدة تظهر باستمرار ويتحرك ملف المخاطر معها، فتقييم يتوقف يصبح قديماً فوراً.
